resources.string: New messages and matches while the app is closed.
You also hear about a new match. Likes are never announced.
Show the name and the text
The notification shows who wrote and what. Turn this off to see only that something arrived. Your phone can hide the content on the lock screen as well.
Keep receiving when the app is closed
A small permanent notification keeps the app connected to the relays. It needs no Google service and uses a little battery. Without it messages arrive when you open the app.
Android asks for your permission before an app may show notifications.
Tap to open. You can turn this off in the settings.
